set.body: Deferred architectural decision. The current contract remains explicit copy-only interop, with neither core depending on the other. Allocation-free fixed-rank indexing and consuming NDArray.build/ArrayBuilder construction are complete. Do not migrate Gale storage until a safe monomorphic Double kernel-view SPI is accepted, explicit zero-copy ownership and layout compatibility rules exist, and a nonproduction DVec/DMat prototype has matched JVM and Scala.js evidence showing Gale indexing, vector, matrix, builder, factorization, allocation, and backend hot paths are neutral or faster without hidden copies. Preserve DVec and DMat as Gale mathematical types; if adopted, keep dependency direction Gale to Ravel and keep linear algebra, backend selection, FFM, and native storage in Gale. A documented no-go is acceptable and retains copy-only interop.
set.title: Decide whether Gale should adopt Ravel-backed dense storage
